# Senate results page — implementation plan (rev 2, after Opus review r1)

Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-senate-results-design.md` (authoritative; §3 is the data contract). Research: `docs/analysis/senate-research.md`. Review: `docs/superpowers/reviews/2026-10-10-senate-opus-spec-plan-review-r1.md`. Design mockup (frozen by the owner before Task 5): `docs/superpowers/mockups/senat-mockup.html`. Branch `senate/results`. Plain JS ESM, no TypeScript, UI copy Czech, `TZ=UTC` tests.

**Rules for every task:** touch only the files named; do not edit anything under `cloudflare/`, `src/`, `public/`, `api/`, `index.html`, `vitest.config.js`, root `package.json` (the orchestrator owns root files); do not commit (the orchestrator commits after review); do not call `wrangler deploy` (only `--dry-run` where stated); no network in tests (fixtures only); minimal code, no speculative abstractions. Scratch data (already downloaded; do not re-download): `SCRATCH=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-vislousv-SyncThing-70-AI-pirati-elec-tracker--claude-worktrees-interesting-einstein-b5e656/f0747433-5c3b-4a51-85cf-03c61970bbf3/scratchpad`, files under `$SCRATCH/feeds/` (`odata_vysledky.xml` frozen 2026; `h24/odata_vysledky.xml` 2024 final, both rounds — a **parser/derive fixture only**: its obvod set differs from the manifest and its `generated` is 2026-09-14; `reg/serk.json`, `cis/cpp.json`, `cis/cns.json` (key `položky`; `serk.json` uses `polozky`), `navig_obvody.json`).

## Layout
```
cloudflare-senat/   package.json  vitest.config.js  wrangler.jsonc  README.md
  fixtures/         se2026-frozen.xml  se2024-final.xml  (+ small hand-made XMLs)
  scripts/          build-manifest.mjs  gen-rev.mjs  mock-upstream.mjs
  src/              xml.js time.js manifest.js normalize.js derive.js rev.js validate.js feed.js refresh.js edge.js worker.js  + *.test.js
senat/              index.html  vite.config.js  src/ (all CSS classes prefixed `snt-`)  public/{humans.txt,kontakt.txt,.well-known/security.txt}
```
Root edits (orchestrator only, Task 0): `package.json` scripts `"test:senat": "TZ=UTC vitest run --config cloudflare-senat/vitest.config.js"`, `"build:senat": "vite build --config senat/vite.config.js"`; `eslint.config.js` `globalIgnores` += `'senat/dist'`. Root `vitest.config.js` is **not** touched (a red Senate test must never gate Prague's `deploy.yml`); `npm test` (Prague) stays as is, the Senate gate is `npm run test:senat`. Because the root `npm run lint` covers all files, Senate code must be lint-clean before every commit.
`security.txt` content: `Contact: tel:+420777954389`, `Expires: 2027-10-10T00:00:00Z`, `Preferred-Languages: cs, en`. CSS: class names `snt-…` only (Tailwind v4 scans the whole repo; do not edit `src/index.css`).

## Cut line (time-box — counting starts ~15:00; staging by ~14:00)
Minimal path = Task 0, 1, 2, 3a, 3b, 4, a plain client from Task 5 (header, tiles, 18 cards, detail table; no screenshots-matrix, no mock-upstream drill). Everything marked *(stretch)* is dropped first. Gate to staging: `npm run test:senat`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` (Prague, unchanged), `npm run build`, `npm run build:senat`.

## Task 0 — scaffold (orchestrator)
`npm ci` at the root; create `cloudflare-senat/package.json` (private, `type: module`, devDependency `wrangler ^4.147.0`) + `npm install` there; `cloudflare-senat/vitest.config.js` (include `cloudflare-senat/**/*.test.js`, `senat/**/*.test.js`, `exclude: [...configDefaults.exclude]`); root script/eslint edits above; copy the two XML fixtures; confirm the Prague test suite still passes.

## Task 1 — manifest, XML parser, time, normaliser, rev  (Sonnet)
1. `scripts/build-manifest.mjs`: inputs `serk.json`, `cpp.json`, `cns.json`, `navig_obvody.json` (paths as args) + the owner list; writes `src/manifest.js` exporting `CANDIDATES` (`"<obvod>:<no>"` → `{first,last,pre,post,age,job,residence,party,partyCode,member,ballotLabel}` where `ballotLabel` = registry `NAZEV_VS`, `party` = `NAZEV_STRN` of `NSTRANA`, `member` = `NAZEV_STRP` of `PSTRANA`, optional missing → `null`), `PIRATE_BACKED` (`[{obvod,no,relation}]`), header comment (sources + SHA-256 + date). Owner list (obvod: surname → expected `obvod:no`): ticket (must have `NSTRANA === 720`, else exit non-zero): Šípová `30:2`, Luftová `18:5`, Szyja `75:2`; endorsed: Šarapatka `21:2`, Smoljak `24:2`, Padevět `27:7`, Plevný `3:1`, Hluštíková `6:4`, Štross `33:5`, Dvořák `45:7`, Grulich `48:2`, Černý `51:4`, Třetina `54:2`, Grolich `57:2`, Papoušek `60:1`, Kohajda `66:1`, Pešatová `69:6`, Šimetka `72:3`. Resolve by obvod + surname containment (case-insensitive); each must match **exactly one** row. Run it; keep the output.
2. `src/xml.js` `parseResultsXml(text)` → `{generated, obvody:[{n,name,candidates:[{no,first,last,pre,post,votes1,pct1,st1,votes2,pct2,st2}], ucast:{1:{…},2:{…}}}], country:{1,2}}`; attribute-only regex parser, entities `&amp; &lt; &gt; &quot; &apos; &#N; &#xH;`, numbers as numbers, absent optional → `null`; **throws** on: no `VYSLEDKY` root, `<CHYBA>`, zero `OBVOD`, `OBVOD` without candidates or without `UCAST`, non-numeric numeric attributes; unknown attributes ignored; unknown status strings are kept verbatim for the normaliser to map.
3. `src/time.js`: `parsePragueTime(str)` → epoch ms with Europe/Prague DST (+02:00 from the last Sunday of March 01:00 UTC to the last Sunday of October 01:00 UTC, else +01:00; ambiguous local hour resolves to the first occurrence), `null` if invalid. Tests: 2026-10-10 → +02:00; 2026-10-25T01:59:59 → +02:00; 2026-10-25T03:00:00 → +01:00; 2026-12-01 → +01:00; invalid → null.
4. `src/normalize.js` `normalize(parsed, {manifest, now, pollsCloseR1, pollsCloseR2})` → spec §3 snapshot **without** the derived fields (`state/status/rank/official/majority/summary`), with `pirate/party/ballotLabel/member/age/job/residence`, `warnings`. Obvod names from the XML `NAZEV`. Pirate attribution per spec §5 incl. diacritics-insensitive surname verification; unknown status → `null` + warning; the close-of-polls gates of spec §2 (suppress pre-close data; drop round-2 data before `pollsCloseR2`).
5. `scripts/gen-rev.mjs` writes `src/rev.js` (`export const CODE_REV = '<12 hex of sha256(derive.js + normalize.js + manifest.js)>'`); `src/rev.test.js` fails when `rev.js` is stale. (Run the script at the end of Tasks 1–2; a placeholder derive.js may exist.)
Tests (`xml`, `normalize`, `time`, `manifest`, `rev`) on the real fixtures: frozen 2026 → 27 obvody, 154 candidates, round 1, zeros, 18 Pirate candidates with correct relation, **no warnings** (use `now` after the gate); same file with `now` before `pollsCloseR1` → still zeros; 2024 final → round 2 present, obvod 5 `2.KOLO` ×2 with `votes2` 6097/6862 and `ZVOLEN_2KOLO` for no 5, obvod 17 no round 2 (with `now` after the gates); with `now` before `pollsCloseR2` round-2 data are dropped + warning; hand-made XMLs: `&amp;`, missing attribute, `CHYBA`, empty body, garbage, unknown status. Manifest tests: 18 entries, 3 tickets all `partyCode 720`, every key exists in the frozen XML with matching surname, `ballotLabel` of `27:7` mentions "pirátské".

## Task 2 — derivation  (Sonnet; after Task 1 has landed the normalised shape)
`src/derive.js` `derive(normalized)` → adds `state, decidedRound, hasPirate`, candidate `rank, status, official, majority`, and `summary` exactly per spec §3.1 (state order, status order incl. `runoffLeading/runoffBehind`, `runoff-counted`, exact `majority`, ranks only for candidates with votes in the current round). Pure. Tests with synthetic snapshots (helper `mk()`): waiting → counting → counted → `ZVOLEN` r1 → `2.KOLO` pair (`advancing`, `official:true`) → round-2 counting (provisional `runoffLeading/Behind`, `official:false`) → round-2 fully counted without `st2` (`runoff-counted`) → `st2` `ZVOLEN`; **tie** (`NEZVOLEN_SHODA_HLASU` → both `runoffTie`, obvod `tie`); tie for first/second in round 1; ≥ 3 `2.KOLO` where only two carry `votes2` (withdrawn finalist → `rank:null` for the third); `majority` exactness (50.004 % case: 2·votes > valid) and only when `Z=C && !official`; an obvod without Pirates; summary buckets Σ = `total`; every state/status reachable once. Real fixtures: frozen 2026 → `decided 0, waiting 27`, Pirate `waiting` = 18; 2024 final → obvod 17 `elected` r1, obvod 5 `elected` r2, `summary.decided` 27, no `official:false` candidate, 5 decided in r1 and 22 in r2.

## Task 3a — validator  (Sonnet; after Task 1)
`src/validate.js`: `validateCandidate(candidate, good, ctx)` → `{outcome:'ok'|'older'|'rejected', reason?, quarantinable:boolean}` and `snapshotHash`, per spec §4 (hard rejects, quarantinable structural changes, `older` and regression only when the baseline applies: `good.generatedMs >= pollsCloseR1` ∧ `good` refreshed after it ∧ same `base`; regression covers `Z`, votes, official flags; official flag change is `rejected` + quarantinable; soft checks → `warnings`). Tests: each rule; pre-close good snapshot is replaced by a zero-then-real candidate immediately (test data reset to zero accepted); 2024-final fixture → structurally valid vs. itself; withdrawal (candidate count −1) quarantinable; `2.KOLO → NEZVOLEN` change quarantinable.

## Task 3b — feed + refresher  (Sonnet; after Tasks 1–3a)
`src/feed.js` `createSenatFeed({baseUrl, fetchImpl, userAgent, manifest, now})` → `{build({signal, validators}), invalidate()}`: conditional GET (`If-None-Match`/`If-Modified-Since` only when `validators` given), headers `User-Agent`, `Accept: application/xml`; 8 s timeout via `AbortSignal`; 304 → `{notModified:true}`; 200 → `parseResultsXml → normalize → derive`, `fetchId` = per-instance counter of HTTP 200s, returns `{snapshot, validators:{etag,lastModified}, fetchId}`; any other status / XML error → throws. `src/refresh.js`: **copy `cloudflare/refresh.js` (read-only) and adapt** — remove `kind`/overview/merge/`complete`/`firstClass`/council `phaseOf`; `createRefresher({now, random, storage, feed, base, log, pollsCloseR1, pollsCloseR2, waitUntil})`; keep single-flight, rehydrate `base`/`meta.schema` (`'1:'+CODE_REV`) discard, persisted `{snapshot, meta}` in one `put`, size guard, backoff, `older`, quarantine (3 distinct fetches/≥ 2 min), `feed.invalidate()` on non-ok. **Validators live only in `good.meta` and are written only by `install()`; the next fetch after any non-ok outcome is unconditional; a 304 resets `failures`/`stale` and advances `refreshedAt`/`nextRefreshAt`.** Export `phaseOfSnapshot(snapshot)` → `waiting|counting|idle|final` and `computeNextRefreshAt` per spec §2. Tests (port only relevant cases from `cloudflare/refresh.test.js`): 304 path; **rejected 200, then 304 stays stale and re-fetches unconditionally**; zone-less `generated` under TZ=UTC; 2000 concurrent `get()` → 1 upstream call; simulated 5-minute counting run (ČSÚ publishes each 60 s, 50 `get()`/s → upstream calls in [5, 15]); failure/timeout/empty/`CHYBA` keep last-good and serve `stale:true`; quarantine acceptance after 3 distinct 200 fetches with the *same stable* corrected file; `older` (no backoff, not stale); pre-`pollsCloseR1` baseline; rehydrate discards on wrong `base`/`schema`/`CODE_REV`; phase scheduling (`waiting` 60 s, `counting` clamp, junk `generated` → +20 s, `idle` 5 min, `final` 10 min); size guard.

## Task 3c — edge  (Sonnet; parallel with 3a/3b)
`src/edge.js`: copy of `cloudflare/edge.js` (`edgeTtl`, `cacheControlFor`, `markStale`, `lastResortRequest`, `withTimeout`, `LAST_RESORT_TTL`), caps per spec §2 (5 s for `waiting`/`counting`/stale, 300 s `idle`, 600 s `final`); keep `"stale":` within the first 300 chars of the body (meta spliced first, as Prague's `respond()`), and `phase` included in the published meta. Port `cloudflare/edge.test.js` cases that still apply.
